title: Clinking Curio Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled in a sun-dappled grotto of swaying kelp and sunken brass trinkets, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its hours sorting tumbled sea glass, softly clinking the shards into intricate, ever-shifting mosaics across the sand. Whenever a visitor leans close, it hovers at the glass and ripples with warm, luminous patterns, eagerly trading chromatic riddles for a moment of shared curiosity.
